findings.excerpt:
calc
      _ = (X:ℝ)^(99/100:ℝ) := by rw [←Real.rpow_add hp]; norm_num
      _ = (X:ℝ)^(-(1/100:ℝ))*(X:ℝ)^(1:ℝ) := by
        rw [←Real.rpow_add hp]; norm_num
      _ = _ := by rw [Real.rpow_one]
findings.problem: The calculation introduces an intermediate exponent and expands X into X^1 solely to combine exponents. Real.rpow_add_one handles the latter product directly.
findings.proposed_change:
Replace this calc block with:
    rw [← Real.rpow_add hp, ← Real.rpow_add_one (ne_of_gt hp)]
    norm_num
findings.benefit: Both sides are reduced directly to powers with equal exponents, preserving the mathematical idea while removing intermediate equalities. The existing hp supplies the required nonzero base, so the replacement introduces no issue at X = 0.
